description: This Java class 'ConfigField' is part of a UI module for configuring system fields, likely used in an embedded or configurable system. It provides UI components for entering and displaying configuration values, handles messages for updating its state, and includes utility methods for extracting numeric values from configuration images.

classes.name: ConfigField
classes.description: A UI component for editing a configuration field with real-time message listening and value parsing.

methods.name: ConfigField
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UI component, sets up message listening, and key event handling.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Updates the text field with the given value.

methods.name: loadValue
methods.description: Loads a value from a ConfigurationImage into the UI component.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a numeric value from a ConfigurationImage based on the Field type.

methods.name: getFloatValue
methods.description: Retrieves a float value from a ConfigurationImage with formatting hack for precision.

methods.name: getIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value from a ConfigurationImage.
